top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 10 children were missing special care needs information in their admission paperwork.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All outdoor equipment observed have exposed pinch, crush, or shear points, on or underneath it. It was observed nails and bolts out of the wood and plastic parts.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic CO Detection Sys Connected to Alarm/Smoke Detection Sys-Tested Annually by Company or State or Local Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5537(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has the smoke detector/Carbon monoxide detector connected to an alarm system. The alarm panel system has not been inspected by a system monitoring company since 10/4/22.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Parents' Information (26 TAC §746.605(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: When reviewing children files, parent information was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used for transportation has not been serviced. Fire extinguisher is empty at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operations director still lacked annual required training topics.
